why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance, with columns for when, what and amount. Refund rows read "Refund: <action>" (환불: … in Korean) and are tinted green. The backend endpoint feeds it, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. I didn't open the page in a browser. ESLint reports seven warnings on the page file. Six are unused imports and one is an unused `tCommon`; all were already there. I didn't change `page.tsx` for any of them.

+    def refund_credits(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str) -> bool:
+        """
+        Gives back the credits charged for an action whose AI work failed and
+        records a positive transaction. Never raises: a refund problem must not
+        hide the original failure. Returns True if credits were returned.
+        """
+        try:
+            session.rollback()  # leave any failed transaction before refunding
+            workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)

+            tier = workspace.tier if workspace.tier else "free"
+            cost = self.PRICING.get(action_type, {}).get(tier, 5)
+
+            workspace.credits += cost
+            session.add(workspace)
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=workspace_id,
+                user_id=user_id,
+                amount=cost,
+                action_type=f"refund_{action_type}",
+                timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+            ))
+            session.commit()
+            return True
+        except Exception:
+            session.rollback()
+            return False
+

diff --git a/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1c02822
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+"""Users must not pay for AI work that failed."""
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post(
+        f"{API}/characters",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id, "appearance_tags": ["tall"], "default_mood": ["calm"]},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def transactions():
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return [(t.action_type, t.amount) for t in s.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all()]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+    assert ("refund_generate_project_cover_image", 15) in transactions()
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 485
+    assert not [t for t in transactions() if t[0].startswith("refund_")]
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+    assert ("refund_generate_character_sheet", 20) in transactions()
+
+
+def test_successful_character_sheet_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 480
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(
+        f"{API}/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "tall", "style": "webtoon"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_failed_synchronous_ai_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    calls = [
+        ("post", "/projects/worldview/augment", {"description": "x", "title": "t", "genres": []}),
+        ("post", f"/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", None),
+        ("post", "/scenes/structure", {"script": "hello", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("post", "/scenes/render", {"prompt": "hello", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("post", "/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": "data:image/png;base64,AAAA", "instruction": "x", "project_id": pid}),
+    ]
+    for method, url, body in calls:
+        try:
+            r = getattr(client, method)(f"{API}{url}", headers=h, **({"json": body} if body is not None else {}))
+            assert r.status_code >= 400, (url, r.status_code, r.text)
+        except RuntimeError:
+            pass  # unhandled server error re-raised by the test client
+        assert credits(client, h) == 500, url
+
+
+def test_refund_never_makes_credits_for_unknown_workspace(client):
+    from uuid import uuid4
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.services.billing import billing_service
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        assert billing_service.refund_credits(s, uuid4(), uuid4(), "generate_image") is False
+
+
+def workspace_id(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    wid = workspace_id(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    r = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("refund_generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+    ]
+    assert all(i["created_at"] for i in items)
+
+
+def test_credit_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = workspace_id(client, h)
+    client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}", headers=h)  # triggers the daily refill
+    items = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h).json()
+    assert ("daily_refill", 50) in [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_is_404_for_non_members(client):
+    owner = signup(client, "owner@example.com")
+    other = signup(client, "other@example.com")
+    wid = workspace_id(client, owner)
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    from uuid import uuid4
+
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
